input.quote: Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Client — Section 2(a) expressly preserves our freedom to build or buy competing software. However, Section 8(d) makes the Credit Data licence "subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement", an instrument not defined or attached here; we should review that agreement to confirm it imposes no restraint on Client's business before signing off. No redline to this document.

input.quote: Subject to the foregoing, Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface.
input.rationale: The licence itself is non-exclusive, but Section 3(i) obliges Client to source a credit report from TrueLink for every borrower underwritten through the Interface, with no performance-based exit — effectively a sole-source requirement for the term (1 year, auto-renewing). We narrowed it to Interface transactions and added an exit where TrueLink misses the Section 3 service levels or cannot supply the data.
